svg.title: Terminal graphics, 1875–2024
svg.desc: An overview timeline from 1875 to 2024 with seven horizontal bands: character art from typewriter art to Usenet ASCII art; mosaic characters and DRCS from Ceefax, Prestel, and Minitel to Unicode 16 octants; character rendering software from AAlib to chafa; Tektronix and DEC terminals from the Tektronix 4010 to the VT340; videotex and image coding from Telidon to JPEG and the NAPLPS plug-in; software terminals and SIXEL from Tera Term to Windows Terminal, including SIXEL tools from PySixel to gnuplot; and image protocols and proposals from GateOne to the xterm.js image add-on. Years before 1960 are compressed on the axis.
svg.text: Seven traditions on one year axis; years before 1960 are compressed.
